QuestInfo.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Pink Flower Basket
QuestInfo.1: I met a fisherman named #p100# in #m10000000#. He wants to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary and asked if I could get him #b10 #t4031042#s#k for her. According to him, a #p609# can take me to the flower's location. #m10005000#... #m10005000#?!?!?! That's FAR!!!
QuestInfo.2: I got #p100# all #b10 #t4031042#s#k. With these, he can make a beautiful flower basket for his wife on their anniversary. As a sign of appreciation, #p100# got me a whole bunch of screws that were left over from parts of a ship. By the way, if there are this many screws that had fallen out of that ship, then how in the world is it even still sailing...? Is it still carrying passengers???

0.0: How's traveling these days? I actually have a favor to ask you... This time, my wedding anniversary is coming up, and I need flowers. Can you get them for me?

yes.0: Thank you! This time, I'd like to give my wife #b#t4031042#s#k... They have a very pleasant scent, and I heard they're found deep in the forest... They say the place where they exist doesn't let everyone in, only a select few, I think. Something about a #p609# in #m10005000# and something-something...
yes.1: Please get me #b10 #t4031042#s#k. I think 10 will be enough to cover the house with that pleasant scent. Please hurry!

no.0: I understand... But my wedding anniversary is coming up, and I am screwed! Please come back if you have some spare time.

1.0: Ohhh... You got me #b10 #t4031042#s#k! This is awesome... I can't believe you went deep into the forest to get these flowers... There's a story about this flower that says it supposedly stays alive for 100 years. With this, I can make my wife happy.
1.1: Oh, and... since you worked hard for me, I should reward you well. I found some #t4003000#s on the ship. They seem to have been parts from a different ship. They look like something you might need, so take them.

yes.0: If you have time, why not try going back into the forest? You might find some treasure in there. I can't guarantee it, since I've obviously never been there before, so please don't come back complaining to me if all you find is trash.

item.0: You haven't gotten the #b#t4031042#s#k yet. There's a #p609# in #m10005000#, and I heard that it'll take you to the location where the #t4031042#s#k are. Please go into the forest and collect #b#t4031042#s#k for me. I need 10 for my wedding anniversary.
